# Synthetic evaluation evidence

This is a test fixture, not a scientific study or a claim about real users.
The observations describe 527 edited episodes from one show.
A technique appearing in 75% of episodes measures frequency, not improvement.
Edited transcripts cannot establish whether a move was spontaneous or prepared.
A single six-minute trial gave positive subjective feedback for a bundle of rules.
That trial did not isolate personal disclosure or establish applicability to every guest.
The tested bundle asked one question per turn; a previous generic prompt stacked questions.
The intended next step is a limited trial with clear exceptions and evaluation criteria.
